semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The laboratory is involved in developing testing systems for memory components, which is a critical part of the semiconductor value chain.
summary: The Hidekazu Tsuchiya Laboratory at Tokai University specializes in the development of boundary scan testers for memory testing applications. Their work enhances the reliability and efficiency of memory components, and they also provide training on boundary scan methodologies to support skill development in semiconductor testing.
capabilities: Boundary scan testers for memory applications
